units.Nahum 2:8: The foundation was uncovered, and she was going up, and her slave women were being led away like doves murmuring in their hearts.
units.Nahum 2:5: in the roads, and the chariots will be thrown into confusion and entangled in the squares; their appearance is like torches of fire and lightning flashing past.
units.Nahum 2:6: Their nobles will remember and flee by day; they will weaken on their journey, hurry to the walls and prepare their defenses.
units.Nahum 2:7: The river gates were opened, and the royal palace collapsed.
units.Nahum 2:9: Nineveh—her waters are like a swimming pool; they were fleeing and did not stop, and there was no one looking back.
units.Nahum 2:10: They were plundering silver; they were plundering gold. There was no limit to her adornment; they have been weighed down beyond all her desirable vessels.
units.Isaiah 38:10: I said, “At the height of my days, at Hades’ gates, I will leave my remaining years behind.”
units.Isaiah 38:11: I said, “I will certainly no longer see God’s salvation upon the earth; I will certainly no longer see a person
units.Isaiah 38:12: from my family. I left the rest of my life; it went out and departed from me like someone taking down a tent he had pitched. My spirit beside me became like a weaver’s web as she approached to cut it off. On that day I was handed over
units.Isaiah 38:13: until morning, as to a lion; thus he crushed my bones, for from day to night I was handed over.
units.Isaiah 38:14: Like a swallow I will cry out, and like a dove I will murmur. For my eyes failed from looking toward heaven’s height, toward the Lord who rescued me
units.Isaiah 38:15: and took away my soul’s pain.
units.Ezekiel 7:14: Sound the trumpet and judge everything.
units.Ezekiel 7:15: War by the sword is outside, and famine and death inside. The one in the plain will die by the sword, while famine and death will consume those in the city.
units.Ezekiel 7:16: Their survivors will be saved and be on the mountains; I will kill them all, each in his injustices.
units.Ezekiel 7:17: All hands will weaken, and all thighs will be defiled with moisture,
units.Ezekiel 7:18: and they will gird on sackcloth; amazement will cover them, shame will be upon every face among them, and baldness upon every head.
units.Isaiah 38:1: At that time Hezekiah became ill to the point of death. The prophet Isaiah son of Amos came to him and said, “Thus says the Lord: Arrange your household’s affairs, for you are dying and will not live.”
units.Isaiah 38:2: Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall and prayed to the Lord,
units.Isaiah 38:3: saying, “Remember, Lord, how I walked before Thee with truth, in a true heart, and did what was pleasing before Thee.” Hezekiah wept greatly.
units.Isaiah 38:4: The Lord’s word came to Isaiah, saying,
units.Isaiah 38:5: “Go and tell Hezekiah: Thus says the Lord, God of David your father: I heard the voice of your prayer and saw your tears. Behold, I am adding fifteen years to your time.
units.Isaiah 38:6: I will save you from the king of the Assyrians’ hand, and I will shield this city.
units.Isaiah 38:7: This is your sign from the Lord that God will do this thing:”
units.Isaiah 38:8: “As for the shadow of the steps the sun descended—the ten steps of your father’s house—I will turn the sun back ten steps.” The sun went up the ten steps which the shadow had descended.
